title: Short-Form vs Long-Form Video Editing: Reels, Shorts or YouTube?
h1: Short-form vs long-form video editing: reels, shorts or YouTube?
description: How editing short vertical videos differs from long YouTube videos: pacing, hooks, captions, formats and workflow, and how to hire the right editor for each.
intro: Short vertical videos for Reels, TikTok and Shorts and long videos for YouTube both need editing, but they reward different skills. Short-form editing is about a strong hook, fast pacing and captions that work without sound. Long-form editing is about structure, keeping attention over many minutes and making a channel look consistent. Many editors specialize in one or the other. This article explains the difference and how to brief each.
